Phirez International Limited ("Phirez", "we", "us") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect through phirez.ug, how we use it, and the choices you have.
Contact details you submit through our contact form (name, organization, email, phone, message).
Standard technical data collected automatically by our hosting and analytics providers (e.g. pages visited, browser type, approximate location).
To respond to enquiries and quote requests.
To improve our website and services.

We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with service providers who help us operate our website and business (such as our form-submission and analytics providers), under confidentiality obligations.

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information by contacting us at info@phirez.ug.
Questions about this policy can be sent to Phirez International Limited, 2nd Floor, Unicalo House, Plot 11, Archer Road, Kampala, Uganda, or info@phirez.ug.
